title: Silver Plus: Differences from Silver Account
summary: This document explains how the Silver Plus account differs from a Silver Account: it offers tiered APY (3.0% Tier 1, 4.5% Tier 2), up to 15 free withdrawals/month, and ATM fee rebates up to $25/month. It also allows paper statements (paper statement fee $0.00) via account settings, and includes a 0.025% additional relationship APY bonus when relationship criteria are met.
